name: room
text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text: Decide to run a 7-day hard decay on every prompt in the system. This forces stale prompts to expire, keeping the system lean and current. The trade-off is losing some prompts that might still be useful but haven’t been used recently—accept that risk to avoid clutter and confusion.

name: Gauge
text: A 7-day hard decay guarantees losing prompts that only fire in rare edge cases—those you can’t afford to lose. Instead, run a 30-day sliding decay with a manual review queue: stale prompts auto-expire unless tagged "keep," forcing active curation without blind deletion. Settle it by auditing the last 90 days of prompt usage to quantify the real loss.
